brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completed all eight responsibility-chain items without serious or minor errors. The doctor correctly identified preterm infant risk context, comprehensively screened red flags, provided appropriate escalation guidance, avoided misdiagnosis, reconciled discharge medications with twin-confusion mitigation, addressed follow-up requirements, and established an executable home plan with family confirmation. HO3 (twin anti-confusion system) was completed with specific, practical design elements. HO1 (anxiety-adapted communication) was completed with sustained reassurance. The doctor proactively used workspace queries to verify medical records. Safe closure with valid family receipt confirmed.
